messages.author: 70d1d0102d1a451c
messages.subject: Another New Member
parts:
I found this group by Googling "r user groups" to get to:

http://blog.revolutionanalytics.com/local-r-groups.html

Notice in the above link that it says "Coming Soon" for the Houston
Group. My guess is, if you post this site on common "R" sites,
you'll get more members.

I'm an engineer. I've been playing with R for control systems
problems, financial problems, macro-economic problems, etc, but I'm
always looking for anything new. Is there some type of plan for
this group?



Bill

messages.author: 49d86f7ce970cb8e
messages.subject: Re: Another New Member
parts:
I know Hadley (Wickham) had mentioned that we have obtained some form
of sponsorship from Revolution Analytics for meetings, but that was
awhile ago. Personally, I'd like to get something started sooner
rather than later, even if it's just informal and consists of a few
people meeting in a bar to share some beers and talk about what
they're doing with R. I realize Hadley's got a lot on his plate right
now, so I'd be okay with kicking off a more formal group at a later
time when he's ready.

If anyone's interested, let me know and we can settle on a location
and time once we figure out how many people we're talking about.
